CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 10

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 19
   C. 7
   D. 17

3. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 122
   C. 121
   D. 22

4. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 81

6. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 33
   C. 32
   D. 12

7. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

8. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 11
   C. 29
   D. 3

9. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

10. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 4

11. Solve for x: x + 7 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 6

12. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 14
   C. 2
   D. 49

13. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 144

14. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 18
   D. 81

15. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 21
   C. 1
   D. 20

16. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
